summary: Expose a local ESM binding as a live export cell instead of copying its initial value.

target.notes: The exported name and local name must refer to the same binding cell.

caveats: A generated property populated once at module initialization is not equivalent.

tests.name: export reflects mutation
tests.input:
// a.mjs: let x=1; export {x}; x=2
// b.mjs: import {x} from './a.mjs'; console.log(x);

tests.name: function mutation visible
tests.input:
// a.mjs: let x=0; export {x}; export function inc(){x++}
// b.mjs: import {x,inc} from './a.mjs'; inc(); console.log(x);
